learning_objective: 🎯 Roll up your sleeves and use your hands to build amazing 3D crafts using simple everyday materials!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A paper is flat, but when we fold, twist, and roll it, it becomes 3D! This means it pops up and you can hold it in your hands like a real object.
We can turn empty boxes, paper cups, and old newspapers into beautiful toys or pen stands. This is called recycling, and it is great for the Earth!
Building your craft is just the first step. Adding colorful paints, shiny stickers, and pretty patterns makes your creation look spectacular!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Magic Paper Cup Monster!
fun_activity.instructions: Take an empty paper cup and turn it upside down. Paint it a bright color, cut out funny paper eyes and zig-zag teeth, and glue them on to make a friendly desk monster!

quick_recap: ⭐ Folding and rolling can turn flat paper into cool 3D shapes.
⭐ Artists love to recycle old things into beautiful new treasures.
⭐ Decorating our crafts makes them special and completely unique.
